def euler_with_recount(xs, h, y0, f, **derivatives):
    """Euler with recount"""
    ys = [y0]
    for k in range(len(xs) - 1):
        subsidiary_y = ys[k] + f(xs[k], ys[k]) * h
        next_y = ys[k] + (f(xs[k], ys[k]) + f(xs[k], subsidiary_y)) * h / 2
        ys.append(next_y)

    return ys
